findings.evidence: `weightedDegree` is `(Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ w).toAddMonoidHom` at `code/TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/WeilDivisor.lean:255`; Mathlib has `Finsupp.range_linearCombination` at `mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Finsupp/LinearCombination.lean:123`, `Submodule.range_toAddSubgroup` at `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Submodule/Range.lean:238`, and `Submodule.span_int_eq_addSubgroupClosure` at `mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Span/Defs.lean:233`.
findings.fix: Replace the manual `le_antisymm` proof with the generic API, e.g. unfold `weightedDegree` and rewrite by `← Submodule.range_toAddSubgroup (Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ w)`, `Finsupp.range_linearCombination`, and `Submodule.span_int_eq_addSubgroupClosure`.
findings.issue: `weightedDegree_range` proves from scratch that a Finsupp linear combination has range the subgroup generated by its coefficients.

summary: The new material is mostly domain-specific, but one proof manually rederives existing Mathlib Finsupp/module range API instead of reusing it.
